bio: Fisher’s Hotel is a 4* hotel which dates back to 1830, and whilst there have been modernisation we have kept that in keeping within the character of the building. The hotel is surrounded by Gardens for the summer and for the winter there are real fires.  The Graden Room is a classic Victorian Room with views over our stunning gardens, specifically redecorated with afternoon tea in mind, you will be comfortable in stunning chairs, feel like you are swept back in time with crisp white linen and period reproduction crockery.  The head chef has designed an Afternoon Tea menu that covers all of the classics, gives a local feel to tea with for example Perthshire Berries in dark chocolate sauce. The menu is in three parts, “The Boulangerie” our selection of sandwiches, ~The Delicatessen” the savoury selection and “The Patisserie”. The tea finishes with a choice of fresh from the oven scones. Tea would not be Tea without Tea. You will have a minimum choice of eight Suki Tea loose leaf blends. These will be brewed in front of you and you can have unlimited top ups during your Afternoon Tea
